name: b1-blur
prompt: Write docs/branding/blur.py, a small Python 3 script (Pillow only, no other libraries, about 25 lines, no classes). Usage: `python3 docs/branding/blur.py IMAGE.png X0 Y0 X1 Y1 [RADIUS]`. It blurs the box (X0, Y0)-(X1, Y1) of the PNG in place with a strong Gaussian blur (default RADIUS 12) so text inside it cannot be read, and leaves every pixel outside the box unchanged: crop the box, apply ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius) to the crop, paste it back at (X0, Y0), save over the same file keeping the image mode. Wrong argument count: print the usage line to stderr and exit 2. Module docstring: why it exists (the README screenshots and banner showed an internal host name; blur such boxes before publishing).

name: b2-mock
prompt:
In web/src/api/mock.ts the demo data lists a discovered server with the internal host name https://kompanion.kireserver.lan, which shows up in public screenshots. Change only that one line so it reads exactly:
  { url: "https://kompanion.home.arpa", name: "kireserver", version: "0.1.0", discovered: true },
(home.arpa is the reserved name for home networks). Change nothing else.
